name: data-pilot
description: Data Pilot — VS Code extension + bundled engine for exploring test datasets without loading everything.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @data-pilot/contracts && npm run build -w @data-pilot/dql && npm run build -w @data-pilot/engine-stream && npm run build -w @data-pilot/core && npm run build -w @data-pilot/runtime-node && npm run compile -w data-pilot-vscode
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/contracts packages/dql packages/engine-stream packages/core packages/runtime-node && npm run typecheck -w data-pilot-vscode
